_source: docs/v1_physiology_research_candidates.md (supersedes docs/v0_physiology_research_candidates.md), which is itself sourced primarily from Wismer & Christie 1987 (GLFC Special Publication 87-3) plus independently cited peer-reviewed/agency studies per species. Every value below traces to a specific section of that document. Where the underlying literature disagrees, the range given spans the disagreement rather than picking a winner, and the description says so.
_units: All values in degrees Celsius unless noted. range_c/range_f give the best-supported single band; where multiple real bands exist, this is the field-preferendum/agency-tier cluster judged most representative, and disagreements are called out in the description.
_diel_note: Three species (Walleye, Black Crappie, Channel Catfish) have documented low-light/nocturnal feeding-activity advantages -- see diel_active flag. This is not temperature-based and is not used by the threshold matcher; it's informational for a time-of-day narrative line.
